title: Candy Company Stops Production After Cyber Attack
story: CNDY had to stop making candy when their computers were hacked. They are fixing it now.
storyBig: CNDY experienced a cyber attack that disrupted production, causing operational delays and potential financial setbacks.
think: What should companies do to stay safe from hackers?
